title: T11e — Parent acceptance and closure reconciliation
privacy: Neutral fixtures only in git; actual profiles, backups, credentials and deployment evidence remain private.
acceptance: Record actual Mac/mini PC/Pi or agreed-equivalent enrollment, revocation, leases, fencing, cancellation, locks, reconnect and uncertain physical-result outcomes
Verify supported upgrades/prerequisites/update policy and platform lifecycle acceptance without repeating already accepted root/Mac evidence as if new
Retain failure/retry and unknown-device evidence; close the parent only after every agreed acceptance outcome passes or an owner-approved scope change is recorded
validation: Meaningful cross-boundary regressions and required final CI
Explicit selected-target acceptance where service, install or real device behavior is required; static/unit passes do not substitute
escalation: Material acceptance/effort expansion or distinct outcome splitting requires owner agreement
Never change an unowned installation, service, engine or uncertain physical effect without explicit reconciliation

effort.basis: Owner-approved slice, 2026-11-11 (PR #264). Slice T11e of the step "Complete multi-device worker and lifecycle acceptance". Estimate, not a measurement. Numbers backfilled 2026-11-11 at harness 5.4.0 from this estimate (rounded up to a quarter day); the baseline is this estimate, not an original one. Re-estimated 2026-11-11 in agent hours (harness 5.6.0): 0.75 hours agent; reconciliation of recorded evidence only, one PR. Method: a judged rate of about 1.5 agent hours per former focused day, not a calculation, informed by NERV merge history (50 feature and fix PRs #140–#276, previous merge to merge, a throughput proxy: median about 0.56 h, p75 2.1–2.7 h by quantile method, p90 about 5.1 h) and B-046-T02 (2-day estimate, about 0.75 h stated to implement); a step that is a PR of its own takes at least 0.75 h with review and CI, while an agent part that only prepares or records for an owner step may be less. Machine time of real-model or device runs is not counted. Estimate, not a measurement; baselineDays 0.25 kept as history. Re-estimated 2026-11-12 at 0.6x from `work-items calibrate` (median 0.55x over 6 closed steps; bug steps 0.6x over 5): 0.75 h → 0.5 h, min 0.5 h; owner hours and baseline kept.
